review: You Branch Adept Heathcliff is an upgraded version of You Branch Sinclair, being an adept and all. His gameplay loop is to deal damage while burning himself down, as he gets rewarded for having low HP, essentially a berserker ID. As usual, we will start with his always active Passive, which does the following: - Exalted command effect for Lord of Hongyuan Hong Lu, which gives extra Wrath damage on Gluttony base skills for the Heishou Bolus Contamination effect. - Cannot be staggered or drop below 1 HP due to Burn damage. - Gains Burn Count and Bloodflame on Substitute or Returns In. Bloodflame allows Heathcliff to inflict more Burn and Rupture Potency with base skills and SP heal upon staggering or killing an enemy. However, if he is at max SP, it will instead be Offense Level Up and Haste. - Safety belt to prevent Heathcliff from dropping below 1 HP once, and heal based on Burn Potency
